# The Quantum Workshop

> Central hub for **Quantego** (desktop-scale LEGO® models of IBM Quantum System One and System Two) and **RasQberry** (functional Raspberry Pi-based 3D-printed quantum computer enclosures running Qiskit). Educational quantum-computing models for STEM, makers, schools, and event displays. Operated by Robert Lahmann (Karlsruhe, Germany).

## Products

- [Quantego](https://robtech01.github.io/quantum-workshop/#quantego): Authentic-geometry LEGO® models of IBM Quantum System One (49 pieces), System Two (98 pieces), and a 1024-piece high-end edition by Luca Crippa. Single units sold via [Etsy](https://www.etsy.com/de-en/listing/1230799391/quantego-lego-model-of-a-quantum); event/business quantities via direct invoice.
- [RasQberry](https://robtech01.github.io/quantum-workshop/#rasqberry): Open-source educational hardware — Raspberry Pi + 3D-printed enclosure of IBM Quantum System One/Two, running Qiskit locally or against the IBM cloud. Full project at [rasqberry.org](https://rasqberry.org).
- [DoQumentation](https://doqumentation.org): Friendly project — browser-based quantum computing learning resource.
- [Qoffee-Maker](https://qoffee-maker.org): Adjacent project — a coffee machine controlled by quantum measurement results, built on RasQberry.
